Keep them as devDependencies and do not redistribute the trie files. If the team wants zero GPL, swap pt-br for pt-pt (LGPL) and accept weaker/no coverage for ru/uk, or source other data.

install.windows: yes - pure JavaScript: no *.node binaries anywhere in node_modules, no os/cpu/optionalDependencies fields in cspell's package.json, bin is bin.mjs run by Node; cspell is widely used on Windows (VS Code Code Spell Checker shares the engine). Requires Node >=22.18.0 (team has 22.22.0).
install.setup_complexity: one npm line + one cspell.json with per-file overrides + a words.txt; no network at runtime

fixtures: fixtures/08-cspell/: 6 SRT explainer narrations (thermos-en/es/pt/uk, switch-fr/de; 12 cues each) + 4 HTML product pages (site-en/de/es/ru); 12 seeded typos T1-T12 in KEY.json (transposed letters, letter substitution, doubled letters, missing accent, wrong Cyrillic letter, split words incl. one split into two real words); controls with 0 seeded typos: switch-fr.srt, site-de.html, site-es.html. Clean text carries Thermoflask, Kailh, Cherry MX, gf, oklch, WebGL, Anatomy of Things and SKUs KBOX-RED-0065-A2 / CMXR-0045-TYPE1 / TFLK-0500-SCHW. Generated by fixtures/08-cspell/gen.mjs (typos applied by exact single replacement so KEY line/cue numbers are exact).

baseline.what: Nothing automated today (manual proofreading). runs/08-cspell/baseline.sh reproduces the 0/12 result.

candidate_default.config: runs/08-cspell/config-default/cspell.json: language en, imports the 7 dictionary cspell-ext.json files, enableFiletypes srt, overrides map *-xx.{srt,html} -> single locale xx. No project word list, no ignore patterns.
commands: cd fixtures/08-cspell && cspell --no-progress --no-color --config ../../runs/08-cspell/config-default/cspell.json "**/*.{srt,html}"  (exit 1, 54 issues in 10 files)

extra_findings_breakdown.real_gap_words: Colours, neighbours (en-US dict only; en-GB spellings), hero, demo (English tokens in ru page), Grammkraft, Klickleiste (German compounds absent from de-de)

candidate_default.suggestions: cspell printed a fix only for vaccum->vacuum and swtich->switch (common-misspellings list); no suggestions for the other 9 found typos in default output (--show-suggestions not used)
candidate_default.runtime_note: 3 runs: 10.7 / 14.1 / 18.7 s for 10 small files; load average 9-10 on 4 shared vCPU, so heavily noisy. cspell --version alone 0.6 s; a single en file 2.7 s, a single uk file 3.3 s: dictionary loading (uk_ua.trie is 4.4 MB uncompressed) dominates.

candidate_tuned.config: runs/08-cspell/config-tuned/cspell.json + cspell-words.txt. Changes and why: (1) project word list (Thermoflask, Kailh, Cherry, Anatomy, oklch, WebGL, Grammkraft) removes the brand/jargon flags; (2) ignoreRegExpList with patterns for SRT timestamps and SKU codes ([A-Z]{3,5}(-[A-Z0-9]{2,6}){2,}) removes the SKU tokens; (3) minWordLength 4 (explicit default; 5 was tried, see do_not_adopt_notes); (4) per-file language set to 'xx,en' (and 'en,en-GB' for English) so English CSS class names / shared jargon in non-English pages and British spellings pass.
commands: cd fixtures/08-cspell && cspell --no-progress --no-color --config ../../runs/08-cspell/config-tuned/cspell.json "**/*.{srt,html}"  (exit 1, 14 issues in 7 files)

extra_findings_breakdown.words: Klickleiste (German compound 'click bar', absent from de-de; a genuine word)

candidate_tuned.runtime_note: 3 runs: 10.6 / 9.5 / 8.3 s under the same shared-CPU load; not meaningfully different from default (same dictionaries loaded).

languages_coverage.es: no gaps on 12 cues + 1 page (accented and unaccented forms handled; missing accent 'tecnica' correctly flagged)
languages_coverage.pt (pt-BR): no gaps on 12 cues; transposition caught
languages_coverage.fr: no gaps on 12 cues incl. elided forms (l'interrupteur, d'actionnement), cœur, à-coups

limits: T12 'key board' (a word split into two real words) is undetectable by any dictionary checker; real-word errors (form/from, their/there) are out of scope. Max achievable recall on this key is 11/12.

Dual-locale tuning ('es,en' etc.) measurably masks typos that happen to be English words: probe 'cobre'->'cover' in thermos-es.srt is flagged by the single-locale default config and NOT flagged by the tuned config. Trade-off: fewer false positives on code tokens vs. a blind spot for English-shaped typos. Alternative is single locale + a bigger word list.
German compound coverage is incomplete (Grammkraft, Klickleiste flagged); the word list will grow with German copy.

Runtime is 8-19 s per run on this loaded box (mostly dictionary load, ~2.5-3.5 s even for one file); fine for a pre-commit/CI check, too slow for an on-save loop. --cache would skip unchanged files but not the dictionary load.
Three of the seven language dictionaries are GPL-3 (pt-br, ru_ru, uk-ua): dev-tool data only, keep as devDependencies, do not vendor the trie files into the sites.

cspell exits 1 for configuration errors just like for findings ('Configuration Error' on stderr); the wrapper detects this (stderr 'Error' or 'Files checked: 0') and returns 2, so a broken config cannot pass as clean.
JSON output needs the separate package @cspell/cspell-json-reporter (not installed); the wrapper parses the stable 'file:line:col - Unknown word (w)' text format instead.
Suggestions are only printed for words in the common-misspellings list by default (2 of 11); --show-suggestions costs extra time and was not measured.
Sample is small (12 cues per language, one page each); coverage statements are indicative, not statistical.
cspell has no built-in SRT language id; 'enableFiletypes: [srt]' is needed so **/*.srt is checked as plain text (timestamps are digits and were never flagged even without the ignore pattern).
reason: Today 0/12 typos are caught automatically; cspell 10.4.0 catches 11/12 (the 12th is a real-word split no dictionary can see) in all six languages tested, including a missing Spanish accent, a wrong Cyrillic letter in Ukrainian and two Russian errors. Defaults flag 41 non-typos (mostly brand names and SKUs); the tuned config with a 7-line word list and two ignore patterns brings that to 0 false positives on the 3 controls and 1 genuine dictionary gap (German compound). Cost: 5.8 s / 29 MB install, pure Node (Windows yes), ~9-14 s per run on this loaded box; three GPL-3 dictionaries (pt-br, ru, uk) stay dev-only.

wrapper_tests.seeded (all 10 files): exit 1, files_checked 10, count 14 (11 typos, 13 tokens, + Klickleiste) -> runs/08-cspell/wrapper-seeded.json

do_not_adopt_notes: minWordLength 5 (tried, not adopted): drops the 'actu' half of T9 and the 'ento' half of T4 (both still caught via the other half) and would hide genuine 4-letter typos; it removed nothing the word list / SKU pattern did not already remove.
Dual-locale 'xx,en' overrides (adopted in tuned, with the measured blind spot above): if the team prefers strictness, use single locale and add class names (hero, demo) to the word list instead.
@cspell/dict-ru-ru as named in the brief does not exist on npm (404); the correct package is @cspell/dict-ru_ru.
Installing all 7 dictionaries loads ~29 MB and costs ~2-3 s startup per run; only import the locales actually used in a given repo.
Nothing failed or was unsafe; no network access is needed at runtime.
